name: IStyleSetter
signature: public interface IStyleSetter<T> where T : IStyleSetter<T>

docs.summary: Provides a fluent-style API for setting visual style properties on UI elements. The type parameter enables chained calls that return the concrete setter type.

Sets the style property identified by property to the given value and returns the setter for chaining. Generic so a value reaches its typed field without being boxed on the way; TValue is always the property's own type.
